name: Muziris Heritage Project
summary: The Muziris Heritage Project is a Kerala Tourism conservation and tourism initiative across the stretch between North Paravur and Kodungallur, the area of the ancient port of Muziris. Visitors move between restored heritage houses, museums, forts, temples, churches, a synagogue and backwater routes by land and boat.
highlights: Covers the area between North Paravur and Kodungallur on the Periyar river delta
Museums and restored heritage buildings tracing the ancient spice-trade port
Historic sites such as Kottappuram Fort ruins and religious sites of several faiths
Archaeological research at Pattanam in collaboration with the Kerala Council for Historical Research
Backwater boat journeys and beaches within the project area
